dedupe_keys.name: 13 new instances for the mixed capacitated arc routing problem with intermediate facilities under time constraints mcarptif road cleaning problem

description: Mingwei Chen and colleagues publish thirteen benchmarks for road-cleaning routes with intermediate replenishment and disposal facilities. Three instances divide a real road network in the city of Zibo containing three depots, 319 nodes and 962 arcs. Ten additional synthetic instances vary from 27 to 268 nodes and from 88 to 952 arcs. Excel workbooks describe road segments, endpoints, coordinates and intermediate facilities. The landing page also gives the tank capacities, consumption rates, replenishment times and speeds used in the authors' cleaning-vehicle study. The September 2024 deposit is freely available under CC BY 4.0. Network observation dates are not specified, and synthetic instances should be distinguished from the Zibo sub-networks. These files support reproducible tests of routing and fleet-operation algorithms. They are distinct from ordinary household-waste collection instances; no direct link to another catalogue record is documented.
